fusions.name: Through the Seams
fusions.desc: A burst of stings that deals 30 piercing damage, ignoring armour, to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves them [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Joint Seeker
fusions.desc: Fires a sting that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it reaches, with a 25% chance to leave it [Sundered], its armour shattered, for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Layered Comb
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier of comb that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Crawling Mail
fusions.desc: Conjures armour of living bees: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 8% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
